description: Schedule (or reschedule) a ready post for a date and time; it publishes itself then. Choose the networks with platforms — ['all'] for every connected network, or a subset like ['tiktok'] or ['linkedin','instagram']; omit to keep the post's current choice (else the account's publishing settings). instagramPlacement 'story' = Instagram story only; instagramTrialReel only when the user explicitly asks for a trial reel. Everything is checked now: the result lists the networks it will go to and any that can't publish, with the reason. For a NEW post on a date, use generate_posts with scheduledDate.

facebookPlacement.description: Facebook only: 'feed', 'story' (Page story only, no feed post, no caption) or 'feed_and_story'. Omit to keep the account default.

instagramPlacement.description: Instagram only: 'feed' = feed post, no story copy; 'story' = Instagram STORY ONLY — no feed post, no caption, first image or video only; 'feed_and_story' = feed post plus the same media as a story. Omit to keep the account default.

instagramTrialReel.description: Publish to Instagram as a TRIAL REEL (shown to non-followers first, kept off the profile grid; Instagram may share it with everyone if it performs well). Set true ONLY when the user explicitly asks for a trial reel for this post — never on your own. Needs a single video and Instagram among the networks. false withdraws it.

platforms.description: Which networks this post goes to. Omit to use the account's own publishing settings. ['all'] = every network the account has connected. Or any subset the user names, e.g. ['tiktok'], ['linkedin'], ['linkedin','instagram']. Only connected networks publish; the result lists any that can't, and why (not connected, switched off, needs a video).

scheduledFor.description: ISO 8601 datetime with UTC or offset for when to publish (e.g. 2026-10-26T09:00:00+01:00)
